question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

Several days later, / he received a written / comeunication from the magistrate / that the case has been dropped.

options.text: that the case has been dropped

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "comeunication" is a misspelling of the correct word **"communication".**
 
• **Meaning:** The imparting or exchanging of information or news. (संचार)
 
 
• **Example:** Effective communication is key to successful teamwork.
 
 
 
• **Correct Word:** "Communication" (संचार)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**
